Prateek: Quick stitch on INC-892 postmortem actions — I'm consolidating owner/due dates. Please reply with owner confirm + firm due. I'll escalate if not confirmed by EOD tomorrow.
Alana: I'll own the rollout playbook update. Due Thu 2026-03-19 EOD. PR: #456
Sophie: I can take the telemetry dashboard alert rule. Need infra support for query window — target Mon 2026-03-16.
Devon: I'll handle the cache invalidation fix, ETA Tue 2026-03-17. PR in flight: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/789
infra-oncall-bot: Scheduled infra change on Sat 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC; may impact API capacity. :warning:
Prateek: @Mira (infra) can you confirm the change won't collide with the canary window? Sophie we may need to slide to Wed if infra can't support.
Mira (infra): Confirmed — low-risk but will open ticket and add runbook. Ticket: https://redwood.infra/tickets/234. Will monitor the canary window.
Alana: If Sophie needs to slip, let's run a 20% canary first. :thumbsup:
Sophie: Ack. If infra holds, Mon is okay; if not, new ETA Wed 2026-03-18 EOD. Need one small query tweak from infra.
Devon: Confirmed PR #789 will be ready for review by EOD today; aiming for merge Tue morning.
Prateek: Final: please drop a one-line acceptance + due date so I can update the RCA tracker.
Alana: Accept — rollout playbook update — Thu 2026-03-19 EOD.
Sophie: Accept — telemetry alert rule — Mon 2026-03-16 (possible slip to Wed 2026-03-18).
Devon: Accept — cache invalidation fix — Tue 2026-03-17.
Mira (infra): Accept — infra confirm + runbook link — ticket 234, monitoring through canary.
Prateek: Thanks all. I'll paste this into the RCA tracker and ping execs if anything drifts. :pray:
